The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} is used to store items and has 25 slots of capacity before it is full.  All items stored in a location will be accessible to all other workstations in that area automatically and can be reviewed by opening the player inventory when in the area. For more information see [[storage]].

Horizontal and vertical: 6 X 3

Rotation: Yes
